sahneler.ses: Must have, should have, could have. Three past modals, three different meanings.

sahneler.sonra: He must have forgotten | the meeting.
sahneler.not: must have + V3: Neredeyse kesin tahmin, -mış olmalı.

sahneler.once: I didn't study | for the exam.
sahneler.sonra: I should have studied | for the exam.
sahneler.not: should have + V3: Yapılmalıydı ama yapılmadı.

sahneler.once: We had a chance to win, | but we lost.
sahneler.sonra: We could have won, | but we lost.
sahneler.not: could have + V3: Mümkündü ama olmadı. Ayrıca: -mış olabilir.

sahneler.once: You brought | an umbrella for nothing.
sahneler.sonra: You needn't have brought | an umbrella.
sahneler.not: needn't have + V3: Yapıldı ama gerek yoktu.

sahneler.ses: Must have is a strong guess about the past. Should have means it was the right thing to do, but it didn't happen. Could have means it was possible, but it didn't happen. Needn't have means you did it, but there was no need.

sahneler.sonra: Stress can undermine | the immune system.

sahneler.sonra: Trees can mitigate | the effects of floods.

sahneler.once: Clean rivers keep | local wildlife alive.
